title: E75: Method learning for the universal problem-solving algorithm — propose recipe improvements from experience
author: konard
body: Problem: learn the universal problem-solving algorithm from solved and failed experience. Approach: mine append-only event logs, compress recurring sequences, keep candidates proposal-only, and adopt only through issue #656 benchmark-gated human-confirmed promotion. Acceptance: one real-trace method is proposed, gated, and adopted; proposals stay inert; rejected proposals retain reasons; recipe/source parity and the regression floor hold.
